messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Cascade onboarding is seeing p99 spikes on /generate during their morning peak (typical p99 ~1.2s -> spikes around ~2.8s). Proactive suggestion: pilot INT8 quant on model-x-1 and route short requests to model-x-small for latency-sensitive calls. cc @Ciara @Nathan
Ciara: Can run the pilot. Need a small request sample and token-length distribution to pick thresholds. :eyes:
Maya: Dropping a quick bucket sample below and a proposed route key.
```
# token buckets (last 24h sample)
<=64 tokens: 62%
65-256 tokens: 28%
>256 tokens: 10%
```
Maya: Proposed route predicate: `request.prompt_tokens <= 64 && client.tier == \"latency\"`
Nathan: INT8 on model-x-1 typically reduces per-token latency ~22-30% on our A100 pool. Expect a small QA drop (~1-2% on our eval set) — will validate with a focused eval set.
Liam: Routing policy idea: prefer model-x-small for short requests and burst traffic, keep model-x-1 as primary for long/complex prompts. Canary 10% for 48h, automatic fallback on error rates >0.5%.
Ciara: I'll prepare the canary config and qa run. Maya, who is the internal owner for the baseline metrics?
Maya: I'll own baseline capture and post the perf delta. Also FYI — renewal signal: customer flagged as medium risk if perf isn't addressed within 2 weeks. If pilot improves latency, that reduces the risk substantially.
Ashley-CS: Ashley here — customer approves starting a 10% canary tomorrow 09:00 PST. They want daily updates during the 48h window.
deploy-bot: Canary started for cascade-prod at 3032110000; policy={"percent":10,"duration":"48h","target":"model-x-small","fallback":"model-x-1"}
Nathan: I'll push the quant checkpoint and eval script to `refs/heads/cascade/quant-pilot` and tag the PR for review. Will include regression thresholds.
Liam: I'll add routing rule to prod config and wire up p95/p99 dashboards + alerting. Will watch for increased error or quality regressions.
Ciara: I'll collect end-to-end latency, routing distribution, and quality evals; will drop a short report in this thread at 24h and at end of canary.
Maya: Great — marking Cascade as "onboarding: perf pilot" in CRM and noting potential renewal uplift if metrics meet targets. Thanks everyone :rocket:
